name: Fate Foreseen / hand-opt-one-bottom-then-draw
notes: Fate Foreseen costs0 and defends for printed 2 from either hand or arsenal; no source-zone bonus. Opt1 looks only at original top wounding_blow_red; choose bottom, leaving order ['wounding_blow_yellow', 'wounding_blow_red']. Subsequent Sink Below blue bottoms the independent hand filler raging_onslaught_blue and draws wounding_blow_yellow; this persisted hand-card assertion proves the chosen ordering rather than only deck membership. Combined defense 2+2 prevents 4 of incoming Raging Onslaught7, giving life 17. Both cards are Generic and both heroes Ira; this is the first attack so no Ira bonus applies.
